text_block_list.text:
I'm out on a nice walk in the evening one
day
when I suddenly run into a very
sweaty Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've been so busy with dorm duties lately
that I
haven't been keeping regular
mealtimes, you
see...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I got too cavalier with my diet, so when I
weighed
myself the other day, well...
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't want my fans to know I've been
training
extra.
choice_data_list: 相談してくれればよかったのに
choice_data_list_en: You should have come to me for advice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I didn't say anything so they wouldn't
find
out... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So, please, don't tell anyone about this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm going to run up and down the
stairs five
more times! Let's do it
together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yup! You're keeping my secret now, so
you're
practically my partner in crime! ♪

I join in on the rest of her exercises and
help Fuji
Kiseki get back into her regular
weight range!
